name: U.S.S. Defiant, Tough Little Ship
oracle_text:
When U.S.S. Defiant enters, destroy up to one target artifact or enchantment.
Station (Tap another creature you control: Put charge counters equal to its power on this Spacecraft. Station only as a sorcery. It's an artifact creature at 5+.)
5+ | Flying, hexproof
blocked_sentences: Station (Tap another creature you control: Put charge counters equal to its power on this Spacecraft. Station only as a sorcery. It's an artifact creature at 5+.)

needs.what: Station symbols (721) on keyword abilities (5+ Flying, hexproof), plus the Spacecraft rule that the permanent is an artifact creature with its printed P/T (7/4) only at its highest station threshold (5+) and a noncreature artifact below it
needs.why_existing_wont_do: Ability.threshold is accepted only on activated abilities (the packet notes say 'Activated abilities only'); a grant_keyword static with a `counters` static condition would leave the ability on the permanent, which the notes forbid for striations; and nothing gates the Spacecraft becoming a 7/4 artifact creature at 5+ -- a counters-conditioned animate/set_types static would be an invented approximation of rule 721 rather than the station mechanic. The Station activated ability itself (tap_permanents with `as` + add_counters power_of) is expressible, but the reminder's 'artifact creature at 5+' clause is not
